name: Boombrick B-Side
description:
Your music, Spotify and YouTube Music in one player for the TrimUI Brick, with album art, synced lyrics and music that keeps playing while you game.

Features:
- Your music: MP3, FLAC, Opus and M4A (AAC) from the SD card, gapless, with ReplayGain levelling
- Browse by album, artist, song or genre; the queue has shuffle and repeat and is kept between launches
- Covers from the files, folder pictures or the Cover Art Archive, with the screen's colours taken from the album playing
- Synced lyrics from the files, .lrc files or LRCLIB, with the line being sung highlighted
- YouTube Music: search, browse albums and artists, and download songs as tagged Opus files with covers and lyrics; a song still downloading plays as soon as it lands
- Spotify (Premium): sign in with a code on your phone, then play Liked Songs and your playlists at 96, 160 or 320 kbps
- Spotify import: download your playlists' songs, or a single song, from YouTube Music to keep them offline, matched by ISRC or by title, artist and length
- Internet radio: browse and search stations from Radio Browser, save your favourites, and see the song a station is playing
- Play in background from the quick menu: the music goes on while you play a game
- Sleep timer: 15 to 60 minutes, or the end of the track or album, with a fade
- Screen off with Power, with skipping and pausing still working
- Titles and lyrics in every main script, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai and Hindi among them, and emoji; each script's font is downloaded the first time it's needed
- Switch Spotify, YouTube or Radio off in Settings if you don't use them
- Updates for Boombrick and its downloader from Settings

Wi-Fi is used for Spotify, YouTube Music, radio, covers, lyrics, fonts and updates; the music on the card plays without it. Your library and settings are kept in .userdata/tg5040/Boombrick and downloads in Music/Boombrick, so updates never touch them.
author: ujjwal313

changelog.v0.7.9: Spotify audiobooks no longer show as podcasts. Recently played and Most played show on Home as soon as they're switched on, with a card saying they fill as you listen.
changelog.v0.7.8: New Audiobooks tab: put .m4b audiobooks, or a folder for each book, in the Audiobooks folder on the SD card. Each book picks up where you left it, even after quitting; X starts one over. Left and Right skip 30 seconds in a book, L1 and R1 change chapter, and Y lists the chapters. Audiobooks and podcasts play from 0.75× to 2×, set in the quick menu. Make and edit playlists on the Brick: X adds a song to one, Select on a playlist edits it. Audiobooks show in Continue listening, and the sleep timer can stop at the end of a chapter. Home has Recently played and Most played. Settings → Top tabs hides the tabs you don't use, without signing out of Spotify.
changelog.v0.7.7: Menu + volume sets the brightness; Menu + Start quits. The selected item's long text scrolls. Long titles scroll on Now Playing. Search Spotify from the Spotify tab with X. Home shows the latest releases of artists you follow on Spotify. Play in background says it's starting, and quitting can't hang. Search in Settings → Library. Random albums picks full albums before singles.
changelog.v0.7.6: Settings → Library finds duplicate songs and deletes songs, albums, or every duplicate download. YouTube Music marks songs already in your library and doesn't download them again. Playlists read TuneMyMusic's .csv exports, several playlists to a file included. A podcast with more than 200 episodes lists its newest 200, not its first.
changelog.v0.7.5: Reorder Home's sections in Settings → Home sections. Bluetooth headphones' buttons and taps play, pause and skip, Beats and AirPods included. Home's Random albums shows each album's title and artist under its cover.
changelog.v0.7.4: Settings has a Home sections page to switch each of Home's rows on or off, and Home gains Shuffle all songs, Playlists and Podcasts rows. Settings also has an Album view option for the Library: a 4 × 2 grid, 3 across with big covers as before, or a list like Songs. And a Clock option: 24-hour or 12-hour. Home's Continue listening includes Spotify podcast episodes you've started, and a Random albums row picks six albums anew each launch. Playlists can be .csv files, as Exportify exports them; songs you don't have play from Spotify.
changelog.v0.7.3: Settings now checks this fork for updates. Earlier versions asked the original Boombrick, so their Update button can't install B-Side: install 0.7.3 by hand once.
changelog.v0.7.2: New Podcasts tab: continue episodes, followed shows and saved episodes from Spotify, synced places, 30 s skips. Choosing something to play opens Now Playing. Library albums in a 4 × 2 grid. Album pages open on the first track, without Play and Shuffle buttons.
changelog.v0.7.1: Internet radio is back: the Radio tab, saved stations on Home and its Settings switch. Now Playing: Up on the D-pad switches shuffle and Down steps repeat; X no longer shuffles. The Lyrics button under the controls is gone; Y Lyrics stays in the hint bar. Play/pause is no longer highlighted all the time; like the other controls, it flashes when pressed.
changelog.v0.6.0: Internet radio: a new Radio tab plays stations from Radio Browser. Browse the top stations, by country or by genre, search by name, and save favourites, which also get a row on Home. Now Playing shows the station's logo and the song it is playing, and a dropped stream connects again by itself. Radio can be switched off in Settings.
changelog.v0.5.3: Switch Spotify or YouTube off in Settings if you don't use them. Import a single song from a Spotify playlist. The tab row keeps L1 and R1 at the edges and wraps around. Spotify songs of an account Spotify won't stream to are skipped with a message.
changelog.v0.5.2: Bluetooth headphones such as AirPods, which could play nothing, now play. Quitting no longer freezes the Brick when the sound card stops answering.
changelog.v0.5.1: YouTube Music search answers YouTube's question about cookies in Europe, the UK and Switzerland, where it could show "No results" for everything. Spotify songs on a free account are skipped with a message instead of playing nothing.
changelog.v0.5.0: Titles and lyrics in Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi and the other main scripts, and emoji, with each script's font downloaded the first time it's needed. L2 and R2 rewind and fast-forward. Albums on more than one disc stay together and in order.
changelog.v0.4.1: Play in background works with a USB-C DAC.
changelog.v0.4.0: Boombrick now runs on Knulli as well as NextUI and CrossMix. Browse your music by genre, and shuffle all of an artist's songs with X.
changelog.v0.3.3: Settings no longer jumps up and down when you scroll down to the Downloader card.
changelog.v0.3.2: Plays the music on your SD card gapless, streams your Spotify playlists, downloads songs and albums from YouTube Music, finds covers and synced lyrics, and plays on in the background while you game.
